messages:
laura: Heads-up — after yesterday's quant bring-up for robin-v1.2-q4 we saw a small but consistent quality hit in our promptset evaluation. F1 drop ~3.2% on the customer-facing intent tasks. Can we triage why and decide if golden set update or rollback?

pranav: which slices are failing? overall numbers hide where it matters. do we have per-cohort evals?

emily: quick summary: regression concentrated on short instruction prompts (<= 30 tokens) and system-message heavy multistep chains. Not much in long-form. Failing examples often lose named-entity fidelity.

laura: exact query I used to pull failures: ```sql
select id, prompt, expected, pred_q4, pred_fp16
from eval_results
where model in ('robin-v1.2-q4','robin-v1.2-fp16')
and cohort = 'intent_v2'
and f1_fp16 - f1_q4 > 0.02
order by f1_fp16 - f1_q4 desc
limit 200;
```

sara: thanks — looks like a mix of tokenizer boundary issues + subtle rank changes. A few prompts were near-duplicates but tokenized differently under the q4 quantized loader; that changes prefix caching in runtime too.

mike: do we know if dedupe fingerprinting changed after quantization? we use the raw-text hash + tokenization fingerprint in pipeline.

emily: fingerprint drift is real here — q4 runtime uses a slightly different tokenization fallback for unknown bytes. I can run a diff of token sequences and generate a list where tokenization differs.

pranav: operationally, two parallel paths: 1) curate a small golden augment for short-instruction edgecases + rerun evals; 2) sample from low-confidence inference logs (prob < 0.6) and push to labeling queue for quick relabel. Which should be priority?

laura: both, but golden augment is high priority for safety/regression alerts. We should add ~150 examples, stratified: 50 named-entity short prompts, 50 multi-step system prompts, 50 random low-confidence hits from production.

mike: labeling capacity this week is tight. ops-bot shows 12 active labelers. ETA for 150 with current SLA ~ 72h. we can accelerate by bumping to priority queue with +20% pay.

ops-bot: dataset-snapshot created: s3://redwood-evals/snapshots/1723456789-quant-reg-01.tar.gz (checksum: sha256:ab12...)

pranav: also recommend we update dedupe to use normalized unicode + byte-level minhash (k=64) so tokenization drift doesn't cause misses. That will keep the golden set stable across runtimes.

emily: implementing minhash now in a branch. I'll also add a small tolerance so near-duplicates within edit-distance 2 get flagged rather than auto-dropped.

laura: good. action items: emily will produce the tokenization-diff list + PR for minhash by EOD. sara will assemble the 150-example golden augment (can pull 50 low-confidence via the SQL above). mike will confirm labeling queue priority and ETA. I'll coordinate release gating — if regressions persist after golden augment, we'll hold robin-v1.2-q4 in canary and roll back to fp16 for now.

mike: confirmed. I'll open a labeling job: queue id #LQ-8042, priority=high, target=150, due=72h. tagging @label-team.

emily: small snippet to diff tokens I ran locally: ```py
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
for row in rows:
  tok_q4 = t.encode(row['prompt'], model='q4')
  tok_fp16 = t.encode(row['prompt'], model='fp16')
  if tok_q4.ids != tok_fp16.ids:
    print(row['id'])
```

laura: perfect. please drop the token-diff CSV into the snapshot above when ready. also add a short readme describing selection criteria for the golden augment.

sara: one more note — model routing in prod can swap to a cheaper variant if capacity is tight. recommend we pin canary traffic to fp16 while we finish this. will coordinate with infra.

ops-bot: deploy-check: canary_traffic(robin-v1.2-q4) = 5% -> hold (manual gating).

pranav: comms: we'll want a short note to customers on the rollout page if we do a rollback or pin. laura can draft. keep it factual and say we're fixing tokenization/dedup stability.

laura: will draft a short post and drop in #announcements if we change rollout. thanks everyone — loop back once labels and token-diffs are in. :thumbsup:
